purpose: Read-only documentary intake and triage matrix for 35 commercially held cases; preserve historical opaque IDs; do not infer receipt, product compliance, signed limits, method approval or lot release.

proposed_gates.label: Commercial identity and intended use
proposed_gates.minimum_evidence: Manufacturer's actual name, full recipe or specification, age group and intended use, process, packaging, label, license category and matching SKU record.

proposed_gates.label: Signed legal article and limit
proposed_gates.minimum_evidence: Operative FSSAI gazette and applicable article, contaminant or microbiological limit, exclusions, date of effect, signed product-specific rationale.

proposed_gates.label: Approved laboratory test scope
proposed_gates.minimum_evidence: Method, analyte, product matrix, LOQ, sampling plan, method suitability and laboratory accreditation or approved validation.

proposed_gates.label: Representative lot evidence
proposed_gates.minimum_evidence: Representative commercial lot number, traceability, representative sample and its original laboratory certificate of analysis.

proposed_gates.label: Independent QA decision
proposed_gates.minimum_evidence: Reviewed complete dossier, signed regulatory and laboratory approvals, documented deviation resolution and explicit authorised lot disposition.

cases.product: Drinking Water (Purified) sold through vending machine
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Outlet packaging format, point-of-sale route and representative sampling point.
cases.final_legal_question: Is it packaged/sealed water or dispensed at outlet? Find operative drinking-water article; water-matrix Pb method.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Final declared coffee/chicory percentages, form and original Gazette scope opinion.
cases.final_legal_question: FSSR 2.10.4 defines coffee-chicory mixture separately; CTR Ochratoxin A row names coffee, not expressly finished blend. Require legal interpretation. As of 17 October 2026, 2025 published labelling first amendment effective 1 July 2026 requires front-of-pack coffee/chicory percentages. This gives a mandatory piece of commercial evidence; it does not make OTA coffee-only row automatically applicable to final blend.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Label, intended age, directions, license category, full formulation.
cases.final_legal_question: Identify children age and FSDU/FSMP/nutraceutical class; verify correct finished-product lead article and basis.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Fruit crop(s), pesticide identity and residue definition, IQF/whole/mixed processing, edible portion.
cases.final_legal_question: Resolve pesticide ingredient/residue definition × fruit species and processed frozen matrix; no generic 'residues' value.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Manufacturer botanical/extract grade, additives, market label and legal fallback interpretation.
cases.final_legal_question: Edible catechu extract not automatically betelnut or pan masala. Test whether named article overrides generic foods-not-specified row; no approval.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Seedless flesh versus puree/pulp/concentrate specification, added ingredients and solids content.
cases.final_legal_question: Decide fruit pulp vs dried seedless flesh vs concentrate; related pulp-row 5 mg/kg vs copper fallback-row 30 mg/kg are mutually non-interchangeable until legal article fixed.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Coconut/dairy ingredient BOM and spray-dried final composition.
cases.final_legal_question: Plant coconut powder cannot assume animal milk concentration factor; rule out specific processed food/ingredient before generic lead row.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Bean versus nib/roasted sample identity and fat/moisture.
cases.final_legal_question: Cocoa beans are not cocoa powder. Analyze any specific cocoa-bean row before candidate generic lead fallback; no powder 5 dry-fat-free transfer.

cases.product: Dry Mixtures of Cocoa and Sugars
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Final cocoa and sugar percentages plus dry-mix identity.
cases.final_legal_question: Cocoa+sugar mix is not powder or pure sugar; evaluate composite-food article then potential fallback, avoiding dry-fat-free cocoa limit.

cases.product: Cocoa mass or Cocoa/Chocolate Liquor and Cocoa Cake
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Separate mass/liquor versus press cake SKU and fat percentage.
cases.final_legal_question: Cocoa liquor and press cake need separate classification; 5 mg/kg cocoa powder comparator cannot automatically transfer.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Botanical Salvia hispanica authentication and whole/ground form.
cases.final_legal_question: Chia botanical seeds are not automatically cereal grains, pulses or a named metal commodity; check any oilseed-specific lead provisions before fallback.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Authenticated Ceratonia siliqua roasted-pod powder identity.
cases.final_legal_question: Carob pod powder not cocoa powder; identify exact commodity then inspect generic row as candidate.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Plant species, purified starch versus flour, origin, named residue and process/concentration factor.
cases.final_legal_question: Arrowroot rhizome starch is not automatically potato/cassava root or cereal; select pesticide×commodity and justify processing factor.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Trapa nut flour identity and additives/mixture proof.
cases.final_legal_question: Water chestnut flour is not cereal grain merely by being labelled atta; assess named flour status then lead fallback.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Species, tissue, cleaned/brined/dried state and test basis.
cases.final_legal_question: Animal natural casings not automatically muscle meat/offal; check specific casing versus generic food basis, moisture/salt.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Pesticide identity and whole/yolk/albumen dehydration factor.
cases.final_legal_question: Fresh shell-free egg MRL cannot be copied to dry egg powder without named analyte and lawful reconstitution/drying factor.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Named residue, species, egg/brine composition and test portion.
cases.final_legal_question: Pickled egg plus brine/oil is not simple shell-free raw egg; decide test material and residue definition.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Original product standard, DE and measured sulphated ash.
cases.final_legal_question: Lead starch-conversion special row requires sulphated ash exceeding 1%; do not apply without original batch ash and supplier identity; compare fallback only with signed determination. *STRONG SOURCE CONCLUSION*: FSSR 2.8.7 sulphated ash ≤1.0% conflicts with CTR special starch-conversion lead article requiring >1.0% sulphated ash. A conforming Dried Glucose Syrup cannot satisfy that named high-ash row. The actual lot still needs composition/identity and another applicable lead legal article plus suitable laboratory evidence.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Dry lactose purity, whey source, moisture, ash method, actual lot and legal food/article mapping.
cases.final_legal_question: Purified lactose not automatically liquid/dehydrated milks or refined sugar; test named milk derivative and impurity rules first.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Original feedstock, manufacturing process and marketed form.
cases.final_legal_question: Misri candy versus refined sugar: verify manufactured form and current chromium entry; no numeric transfer from appearance.

cases.product: Polyols permitted under Appendix-A of FSS(FPS&FA) Regulations,2011 excluding those already standardized
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Individual named polyol with INS/CAS and grade.
cases.final_legal_question: Nickel named sorbitol entry (if operative) cannot be assigned to generic xylitol/erythritol/polyols or blends. Original 29 Nov 2017 notified FSSR Sorbitol product standard directly supplies nickel ≤2 mg/kg and lead ≤1 mg/kg FOR SORBITOL INS420 CAS50-70-4 only; cannot transfer to other polyols or a mixed polyol group. Authenticated exact formula and commodity identity still needed. The official FoSCoS row for this umbrella explicitly says 'excluding those already standardized'; sorbitol is individually standardized under FSSR 3.2.16. Thus importing sorbitol-specific 2 mg/kg Ni into this grouped non-standardized-polyols category is especially unsupported by its own stated scope.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Every potassium/sodium salt and additive in the recipe.
cases.final_legal_question: KCl-rich salt substitute blend not automatically food-grade sodium chloride; identify mixture and test named mineral versus fallback legal article. Original 2017 FSSR 2.9.30(6) specifies differentiated low-sodium salt substitute compositions and sodium ≤120 mg/100g; this supports exclusion of an unexamined common NaCl article. It is NOT a product-specific lead maximum.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Trehalose CAS/grade, current FSSR chapter 3 standard, measured sulphated ash and intended use.
cases.final_legal_question: Trehalose is neither refined white sugar nor specific high-ash starch conversion merely by sweetness; require substance identity and analysis. June 2026 Closed/Withdrawn register includes named Trehalose application; neither means trehalose generically unlawful nor that a specific other applicant's product is approved.

cases.regulatory_route_label: Other substances, enzymes, flavour premixes and functional ingredients
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Exact mineral/CAS composition, original manufacturer and food-grade specifications, license/application status.
cases.final_legal_question: Sajji Khar trade name not enough to choose food or unnamed chemical lead row; verify approved mineral composition and applicable monograph. Four Sajji Khar or Saji/Papad Khar entries within the June 2026 Closed/Withdrawn NSF application section (PDF pp.52–53). Do not interpret as all manufacturers banned; verify actual applicant and any later September 2026 decision.

cases.product: Additives permitted under Appendix-A of FSS (FPS&FA) Regulations, 2011 and other food safety standards regulations excluding those already standardized and additives of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Exact permitted additive INS/CAS, use and supplier grade.
cases.final_legal_question: A group of Appendix A additives requires individual named INS and applicable impurity specification; blanket food fallback is unsupported.

cases.product: Additives VA-VF of Nutraceutical Regulations excluding those already standardised
cases.regulatory_route_label: Other substances, enzymes, flavour premixes and functional ingredients
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Current named additive schedule permission, INS/CAS, carrier, supplier grade and monograph.
cases.final_legal_question: Historic VA–VF nutraceutical additives class must split into current operative listed substances, purity monographs and lead limits.

cases.product: Permitted enzymes and their preparations excluding those already listed under Processing Aids and Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.regulatory_route_label: Other substances, enzymes, flavour premixes and functional ingredients
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Named enzyme EC, production organism, processing-aid/additive use, carriers, impurities and method matrix.
cases.final_legal_question: Enzyme preparation includes organism, carrier, processing aid or additive role; not all carry one lead limit.

cases.product: Ingredients listed under Schedule IV, Schedule VI and Schedule VIII of Nutraceutical Regulations
cases.regulatory_route_label: Other substances, enzymes, flavour premixes and functional ingredients
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Individual Schedule IV/VI/VIII botanical and whether B1 or total target.
cases.final_legal_question: Total/AFB1 entries can include products containing specified nuts/cereals/oilseeds/pulses/spices, but broad supplement schedule cannot inherit without named contents.

cases.regulatory_route_label: Other substances, enzymes, flavour premixes and functional ingredients
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Signed premix BOM and named nuts/oilseeds/cereals/spices.
cases.final_legal_question: Premix may be subject to 'food product containing any of above' aflatoxin rows if BOM includes named groups; verify as-sold mixture.

cases.product: Cow or Buffalo Colostrum and Colostrum Products
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Source species, colostrum stage, dry solids and formulation.
cases.final_legal_question: Colostrum from cows/buffaloes resembles milk but isn't automatically listed 'milks' or secondary milk products; check both article and concentration basis.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Pure versus formulated royal-jelly identity, bee-farm production records, exact antibiotic, legal commodity coverage.
cases.final_legal_question: CTR honey-production MRPL and veterinary tissue rules do not automatically name royal jelly. Need exact antibiotic molecule and bee-product law.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Genuine edible silver fineness and signed operative case classification.
cases.final_legal_question: FSSR silver-leaf purity 999/1000 is a separate mandatory identity/quality standard, not a CTR lead maximum; determine if generic metal/food impurity article legally applies.

cases.regulatory_route_label: Ayurveda Aahara named recipes: category A source reference
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Actual licensed Narikela Ksheerika recipe and coconut/milk proportions.
cases.final_legal_question: Narikela Ksheerika Ayurveda composite coconut/dairy dessert not automatically milk; first confirm applicable Ayurveda Aahara route. Authority's 25 July 2025 listed Ayurveda Aahara Category A recipe is a specific authorized recipe reference; no cow/buffalo generic milk Pb row is thereby assigned to this heterogeneous prepared food. Obtain licensed as-marketed recipe and actual CoA. Corrected original licensing evidence: Sep 1 2025 FSSAI Category A listed recipe can be selected under KoB without a separate HQ product approval letter; Central license and recipe conformity must still be verified. HQ approval required for disease-risk-reduction claims, not implicitly all Category A products. FSSAI 22 Jul 2021 FPC18 sweets/snacks licensing direction explicitly routes FPC18 pollutants to Foods not specified, but product cataloguing as listed Ayurveda Category102 Aahara cannot silently inherit the specific FPC18 direction. Seek case-specific original CTR/Gazette applicability.

cases.regulatory_route_label: Ayurveda Aahara named recipes: category A source reference
cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Actual licensed Ksheerapaka recipe and finished dilution/solids.
cases.final_legal_question: Ksheerapaka Ayurveda milk-botanical composite not automatically liquid milk; current finished identity and processing matter. Authority's 25 July 2025 listed Ayurveda Aahara Category A recipe is a specific authorized recipe reference; no cow/buffalo generic milk Pb row is thereby assigned to this heterogeneous prepared food. Obtain licensed as-marketed recipe and actual CoA. Corrected original licensing evidence: Sep 1 2025 FSSAI Category A listed recipe can be selected under KoB without a separate HQ product approval letter; Central license and recipe conformity must still be verified. HQ approval required for disease-risk-reduction claims, not implicitly all Category A products. FSSAI 22 Jul 2021 FPC18 sweets/snacks licensing direction explicitly routes FPC18 pollutants to Foods not specified, but product cataloguing as listed Ayurveda Category102 Aahara cannot silently inherit the specific FPC18 direction. Seek case-specific original CTR/Gazette applicability.

cases.first_commercial_document_needed: Fibre DP distribution, glucose content, starting starch, sulphated ash and finished ingredient specification.
cases.final_legal_question: Dextrin soluble fibre polymer not solid glucose syrup or named high-ash starch conversion; check substance monograph and candidate fallback.
